geometry_notes: Plain polygonal I, equal top and bottom flange widths; tapers run straight from flange edge to web. All callouts printed; no chamfers drawn.
Midspan Corte D-D modelled; the 70 cm solid end blocks and 15 cm transitions (elevation views) are excluded.
Volume 2 Tabela 2-1 labels PCP-10/PCP-15 'concreto armado pré-moldado' and PCP-20 'concreto pré-moldado protendido'; Volume 1 has an armadura ativa sheet for each module. Recorded, not resolved.

PINNED DISCREPANCY PCP-10: the drawing gives A = 0.2600 m2 (exact) while Tabela 2-5 prints A = 0.267 m2 (+2.7%). yi = ys = 0.35 m and I = 0.014 m4 (calc 0.01354, within print rounding) agree. PCP-15 and PCP-20 reproduce A, yi and I to print precision.
